card.name: Just before luxury or upscale words
card.fires_on: Words or word parts right before an expected luxury term such as luxury, opulent, lavish or high-end. It fires on the slot where such a word would come next, in general web text.

modes.label: Partway through posh words
modes.description: Inside a word that is building toward a lavish or upscale term.
modes.example: the most<< op>>ulent luxury liner of The White Star line

modes.label: Linking word before upscale term
modes.description: A small word like a, an, with or to just before a luxury or high-value description.
modes.example: for a long time these briquettes remained<< an>> expensive luxury

modes.label: Before a price or quality contrast
modes.description: Words in passages on expensive versus cheap goods, where a high-end word could follow.
modes.example: mixing in less expensive spices<< with>> high value spices

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict luxury, luxurious and high-end words, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say something is luxurious or high-end.
